false_all_met.denominator_meaning: fully scored cases where at least one requirement must not be MET

false_met_hidden_by_another_blocker.denominator_meaning: cases with at least one false MET; overall status was not PENDING_VERIFICATION

missed_all_met.denominator_meaning: fully scored cases where every requirement is expected MET

case_level.note: Derived from requirement labels. A case counts only if every requirement has a scored label. Unlike the requirement tables, case-level results use every scored tier together; see label_tiers_used.

ready.reason: No human verifications are supplied, so READY cannot occur. No false-READY rate is reported.

challenge_v1.description: Twenty synthetic notes targeting temporal ambiguity, treatment adherence, contradictory evidence, negation, historical findings and natural clinical phrasing. It includes the failures reproduced in the November 2026 review.
challenge_v1.note_authorship: Synthetic, agent-authored (Claude). Not written or reviewed by a clinician.

unscored_needs_review.question_for_reviewer: Does 'activity modification + NSAIDs and PT x 6 weeks' document a 6-week NSAID course, or only 6 weeks of PT?
Is 'persistent symptoms' an explicit statement of no improvement after the therapy course?
Does the 6-week duration apply to NSAIDs as well as PT?
If the NSAID course has no documented duration, is its response still a linked-course response?

limitations: No label has been reviewed by a human or a clinician. Every scored label is provisional and agent-authored.
All notes are synthetic. No note is real clinical documentation.
The datasets are small and were selected, not sampled. Counts are observed failures on these notes; no population-level error rate is estimated or implied.
The label author had read the extractor source, and for part of the challenge set had seen extractor output before labeling.

The challenge set is adversarial and partly chosen because the extractor was already seen to fail on it. Its counts are a list of known failures. Its proportions say nothing about real-world or clinical performance and are shown without percentages.
The bundled corpus was written alongside the extractor. Agreement on it shows the extractor still does what its fixtures expect, not that it is accurate.
READY is structurally unreachable in this harness because no human verifications are supplied. No false-READY rate exists here.
Labels marked needs_review and requirements without a label are excluded from every rate and listed separately.
Evidence coverage and overlap are weak checks. The extractor often cites a whole sentence, so a cited span can overlap the expected quote and still contain the words that should have disqualified it.
scope: Requirement-level agreement between the production regex extractor and written labels on synthetic notes. It measures extraction proposals. It does not measure authorization readiness, payer approval, medical necessity or clinical accuracy.

holdout_v1.reason: Sealed holdout. Not labeled and never run through the extractor.
